    MANIFEST & RESULTFIG. 02

    Run a comparison

    1. Place A in slot 1, B in slot 2 and C in slot 3. Their combined weight is 6.
    2. Try D in slot 4. Its addition would exceed the teaching limit. The board should stay unchanged.
    3. Remove B, then insert D into slot 4. Inspect and export the new total of 5.

    The JSON ledger is an audit receipt, not a re-importable manifest or a downstream-station handoff.

    REFERENCE ATLAS

    Appliance and teaching fixture

    Exterior reference

    The nominal cabinet envelope is 340 × 583.5 × 332.5 mm (W × D × H), per the Leica operating manual, 12/18, §5.1 printed p. 12. Small features and rear details are inferred; no hidden geometry is modeled. The Leica brochure 02/16, PDF p. 5 distinguishes the four-well holder from other accessories.

    What the verification covers

    The rule adds weights of occupied slots, checks capacity and rejects occupied slots or duplicate markers. Inspection is a snapshot of the current board revision. Moving a marker invalidates that snapshot. This does not simulate drying, material preparation or appliance operation.
